versions.content: The CanTp module shall send a maximum of WFTmax consecutive FC(WAIT) N - PDU. If this number is reached, the CanTp module shall abort the reception of this N - SDU (the receiver did not send any FC N - PDU, so the N_Bs timer expires on the sender side and then the transmission is aborted) and a receiving indication with E_NOT_OK occurs.
